comment:
* Represents ad group times and information on the state and URIs of ads within each ad group. * *

Instances are immutable. Call the {@code with*} methods to get new instances that have the * required changes.

variables.name: AD_STATE_UNAVAILABLE
variables.comment: State for an ad that does not yet have a URL.

variables.name: AD_STATE_AVAILABLE
variables.comment: State for an ad that has a URL but has not yet been played.

variables.name: AD_STATE_SKIPPED
variables.comment: State for an ad that was skipped.

variables.name: AD_STATE_PLAYED
variables.comment: State for an ad that was played in full.

variables.name: AD_STATE_ERROR
variables.comment: State for an ad that could not be loaded.

variables.name: NONE
variables.comment: Ad playback state with no ads.

variables.name: adsId
variables.comment: * The opaque identifier for ads with which this instance is associated, or {@code null} if unset.

variables.name: adResumePositionUs
variables.comment: The position offset in the first unplayed ad at which to begin playback, in microseconds.

variables.name: contentDurationUs
variables.comment: * The duration of the content period in microseconds, if known. {@link C#TIME_UNSET} otherwise.

variables.name: removedAdGroupCount
CREATOR
variables.comment:
* Object that can restore {@link AdPlaybackState} from a {@link Bundle}. * *

The {@link #adsId} of restored instances will always be {@code null}.

methods.name: public AdGroup getAdGroup(@IntRange(from = 0) int adGroupIndex)
methods.comment: Returns the specified {@link AdGroup}.

methods.name: public int getAdGroupIndexForPositionUs(long positionUs, long periodDurationUs)
methods.comment:
* Returns the index of the ad group at or before {@code positionUs} that should be played before
   * the content at {@code positionUs}. Returns {@link C#INDEX_UNSET} if the ad group at or before
   * {@code positionUs} has no ads remaining to be played, or if there is no such ad group.
   *
   * @param positionUs The period position at or before which to find an ad group, in microseconds,
   *     or {@link C#TIME_END_OF_SOURCE} for the end of the stream (in which case the index of any
   *     unplayed postroll ad group will be returned).
   * @param periodDurationUs The duration of the containing timeline period, in microseconds, or
   *     {@link C#TIME_UNSET} if not known.
   * @return The index of the ad group, or {@link C#INDEX_UNSET}.

methods.name: public int getAdGroupIndexAfterPositionUs(long positionUs, long periodDurationUs)
methods.comment:
* Returns the index of the next ad group after {@code positionUs} that should be played. Returns
   * {@link C#INDEX_UNSET} if there is no such ad group.
   *
   * @param positionUs The period position after which to find an ad group, in microseconds, or
   *     {@link C#TIME_END_OF_SOURCE} for the end of the stream (in which case there can be no ad
   *     group after the position).
   * @param periodDurationUs The duration of the containing timeline period, in microseconds, or
   *     {@link C#TIME_UNSET} if not known.
   * @return The index of the ad group, or {@link C#INDEX_UNSET}.

methods.name: public boolean isAdInErrorState(@IntRange(from = 0) int adGroupIndex, @IntRange(from = 0) int adIndexInAdGroup)
methods.comment: Returns whether the specified ad has been marked as in {@link #AD_STATE_ERROR}.

methods.name: public AdPlaybackState withAdGroupTimeUs(@IntRange(from = 0) int adGroupIndex, long adGroupTimeUs)
methods.comment:
* Returns an instance with the specified ad group time.
   *
   * @param adGroupIndex The index of the ad group.
   * @param adGroupTimeUs The new ad group time, in microseconds, or {@link C#TIME_END_OF_SOURCE} to
   *     indicate a postroll ad.
   * @return The updated ad playback state.

methods.name: public AdPlaybackState withNewAdGroup(@IntRange(from = 0) int adGroupIndex, long adGroupTimeUs)
methods.comment:
* Returns an instance with a new ad group.
   *
   * @param adGroupIndex The insertion index of the new group.
   * @param adGroupTimeUs The ad group time, in microseconds, or {@link C#TIME_END_OF_SOURCE} to
   *     indicate a postroll ad.
   * @return The updated ad playback state.

methods.name: public AdPlaybackState withAdCount(@IntRange(from = 0) int adGroupIndex, @IntRange(from = 1) int adCount)
methods.comment:
* Returns an instance with the number of ads in {@code adGroupIndex} resolved to {@code adCount}.
   * The ad count must be greater than zero.

methods.name: public AdPlaybackState withAdUri(@IntRange(from = 0) int adGroupIndex, @IntRange(from = 0) int adIndexInAdGroup, Uri uri)
methods.comment: Returns an instance with the specified ad URI.

methods.name: public AdPlaybackState withPlayedAd(@IntRange(from = 0) int adGroupIndex, @IntRange(from = 0) int adIndexInAdGroup)
methods.comment: Returns an instance with the specified ad marked as played.

methods.name: public AdPlaybackState withSkippedAd(@IntRange(from = 0) int adGroupIndex, @IntRange(from = 0) int adIndexInAdGroup)
methods.comment: Returns an instance with the specified ad marked as skipped.

methods.name: public AdPlaybackState withAdLoadError(@IntRange(from = 0) int adGroupIndex, @IntRange(from = 0) int adIndexInAdGroup)
methods.comment: Returns an instance with the specified ad marked as having a load error.

methods.name: public AdPlaybackState withSkippedAdGroup(@IntRange(from = 0) int adGroupIndex)
methods.comment:
* Returns an instance with all ads in the specified ad group skipped (except for those already
   * marked as played or in the error state).

methods.name: public AdPlaybackState withAdDurationsUs(long[][] adDurationUs)
methods.comment:
* Returns an instance with the specified ad durations, in microseconds. * *

Must only be used if {@link #removedAdGroupCount} is 0.

methods.name: public AdPlaybackState withAdDurationsUs(@IntRange(from = 0) int adGroupIndex, long... adDurationsUs)
methods.comment:
* Returns an instance with the specified ad durations, in microseconds, in the specified ad
   * group.

methods.name: public AdPlaybackState withAdResumePositionUs(long adResumePositionUs)
methods.comment:
* Returns an instance with the specified ad resume position, in microseconds, relative to the
   * start of the current ad.

methods.name: public AdPlaybackState withContentDurationUs(long contentDurationUs)
methods.comment: Returns an instance with the specified content duration, in microseconds.

methods.name: public AdPlaybackState withRemovedAdGroupCount(@IntRange(from = 0) int removedAdGroupCount)
methods.comment:
* Returns an instance with the specified number of {@link #removedAdGroupCount removed ad * groups}. * *

Ad groups with indices between {@code 0} (inclusive) and {@code removedAdGroupCount} * (exclusive) will be empty and must not be modified by any of the {@code with*} methods.

methods.name: public AdPlaybackState withContentResumeOffsetUs(@IntRange(from = 0) int adGroupIndex, long contentResumeOffsetUs)
methods.comment:
* Returns an instance with the specified {@link AdGroup#contentResumeOffsetUs}, in microseconds,
   * for the specified ad group.

methods.name: public AdPlaybackState withIsServerSideInserted(@IntRange(from = 0) int adGroupIndex, boolean isServerSideInserted)
methods.comment:
* Returns an instance with the specified value for {@link AdGroup#isServerSideInserted} in the
   * specified ad group.

methods.name: public AdPlaybackState withResetAdGroup(@IntRange(from = 0) int adGroupIndex)
methods.comment:
* Returns an instance with all ads in the specified ad group reset from final states (played,
   * skipped, error) to either available or unavailable, which allows to play them again.
